051public class TransactionCommand {
052
053  //[page #]
054  public static void away(final CmdSource<?> sender, final int page) {
055
056    final Optional<Account> account = BaseCommand.account(sender, "away");
057    final Optional<AwayHistory> away = account.filter(PlayerAccount.class::isInstance)
058            .flatMap(found->found.away(((PlayerAccount)found).getUUID()));
059    if(away.isEmpty() || away.get().getReceipts().isEmpty()) {
060      sender.message(new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.AwayNone"));
061      return;
062    }
063
064    final int selectedPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), away.get().maxPages());
065    final MessageData heading = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.AwayHeader");
066    heading.addReplacement("$page", String.valueOf(selectedPage));
067    heading.addReplacement("$page_top", String.valueOf(away.get().maxPages()));
068    sender.message(heading);
069
070    for(final UUID id : away.get().getPage(selectedPage)) {
071      account.get().findReceipt(id).ifPresent(receipt->sender.message(line(account.get(), receipt)));
072    }
073  }
074
075  //[page:#] [world:name/all] [player:name]
076  public static void history(final CmdSource<?> sender, final int page, String region, final Account account) {
077
078    if(sender.player().isPresent() && !account.getIdentifier().equals(sender.identifier().orElse(null))
079       && !sender.player().get().hasPermission("tne.transaction.history.other")) {
080      sender.message(new MessageData("Messages.General.NoPerm"));
081      return;
082    }
083
084    region = TNECore.eco().region().resolve(region);
085
086    final SortedHistory sorted = account.getSorted(account.getIdentifier());
087
088    if(sorted == null || sorted.getReceipts().isEmpty()) {
089      sender.message(new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.HistoryNone"));
090      return;
091    }
092
093    final int selectedPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), sorted.maxPages());
094    final MessageData heading = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.HistoryHeader");
095    heading.addReplacement("$page", String.valueOf(selectedPage));
096    heading.addReplacement("$page_top", String.valueOf(sorted.maxPages()));
097    sender.message(heading);
098
099    for(final UUID id : sorted.getPage(selectedPage)) {
100      sendHistoryEntry(sender, account, id);
101    }
102  }
103
104  private static void sendHistoryEntry(final CmdSource<?> sender, final Account account,
105                                       final UUID id) {
106
107    account.findReceipt(id).ifPresent(receipt->sender.message(line(account, receipt)));
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * One transaction as the given account saw it: when, what, how much it gained or lost and with
112   * whom. The ID is in the hover text and the click opens its details.
113   */
114  private static MessageData line(final Account account, final Receipt receipt) {
115
116    final boolean received = receipt.getTo() != null && receipt.getTo().getId().equals(account.getIdentifier());
117    final MessageData line = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Line");
118    line.addReplacement("$id", receipt.getId().toString());
119    line.addReplacement("$date", date(receipt.getTime()));
120    line.addReplacement("$type", receipt.getType());
121    line.addReplacement("$amount", amount(account, received? receipt.getModifierTo() : receipt.getModifierFrom()));
122    line.addReplacement("$other", otherName(receipt, received));
123    return line;
124  }
125
126  private static String date(final long time) {
127
128    try {
129      return DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(MessageConfig.yaml().getString("Messages.Transaction.DateFormat", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"))
130              .format(Instant.ofEpochMilli(time).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()));
131    } catch(final IllegalArgumentException invalidPattern) {
132      return DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE.format(Instant.ofEpochMilli(time).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()));
133    }
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * The signed change, e.g. "+$10.00" or "-$5.00". Receipts saved before modifiers were stored
138   * have none.
139   */
140  private static String amount(final Account account, final HoldingsModifier modifier) {
141
142    if(modifier == null) {
143      return "-";
144    }
145    final BigDecimal change = modifier.getOperation() == HoldingsOperation.SUBTRACT? modifier.getModifier().negate()
146                                                                                : modifier.getModifier();
147    final String sign = change.signum() < 0? "-" : "+";
148    if(modifier.isPercent()) {
149      return sign + change.abs().toPlainString() + "%";
150    }
151    return sign + CurrencyFormatter.format(account, new HoldingsEntry(modifier.getRegion(), modifier.getCurrency(),
152                                                                      change.abs(), EconomyManager.NORMAL));
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * The account on the other side, or for gives, takes and plugin transactions without one,
157   * whoever caused it.
158   */
159  private static String otherName(final Receipt receipt, final boolean received) {
160
161    final TransactionParticipant other = received? receipt.getFrom() : receipt.getTo();
162    if(other != null || receipt.getSource() == null) {
163      return participantName(other);
164    }
165    return TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(receipt.getSource().name())
166            .map(Account::getName)
167            .orElse(receipt.getSource().name());
168  }
169
170  private static String participantName(final TransactionParticipant participant) {
171
172    if(participant == null) {
173      return "None";
174    }
175    return participant.asAccount().map(Account::getName).orElse("None");
176  }
177
178  //<uuid>
179  public static void info(final CmdSource<?> sender, final UUID uuid) {
180
181    final Optional<Receipt> receipt = TransactionManager.receipts().getReceiptByUUID(uuid);
182
183    if(receipt.isEmpty()) {
184      final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Invalid");
185      message.addReplacement("$transaction", uuid.toString());
186      sender.message(message);
187      return;
188    }
189
190    final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Info");
191    message.addReplacement("$id", uuid.toString());
192    message.addReplacement("$type", receipt.get().getType());
193    sender.message(message);
194  }
195
196  //<uuid>
197  public static void voidT(final CmdSource<?> sender, final Account account, final UUID uuid) {
198
199    final Optional<Receipt> receipt = account.findReceipt(uuid);
200
201    if(receipt.isEmpty()) {
202      final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Invalid");
203      message.addReplacement("$transaction", uuid.toString());
204      sender.message(message);
205      return;
206    }
207
208    if(receipt.get().isVoided()) {
209      final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Already");
210      message.addReplacement("$transaction", uuid.toString());
211      sender.message(message);
212      return;
213    }
214
215    final boolean voided = receipt.get().voidTransaction();
216    if(!voided) {
217      final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Unable");
218      message.addReplacement("$transaction", uuid.toString());
219      sender.message(message);
220      return;
221    }
222    final MessageData message = new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.Voided");
223    message.addReplacement("$transaction", uuid.toString());
224    sender.message(message);
225  }
226}
